rule_audit.name: Notice for tenant breach materially affecting health and safety
rule_audit.label: Notice for tenant breach materially affecting health and safety (R.C. 5321.11)
rule_audit.summary: For covered R.C. 5321.05 breaches materially affecting health and safety, the written notice must specify the noncompliant act or omission and a termination date at least thirty days after receipt; timely remedy prevents termination.
rule_audit.excerpt: Statement of Facts The plaintiff-landlord served the defendant-tenant with a written notice specifying a covered breach and a termination date. Argument The landlord is entitled to possession under R.C. 5321.11. The written notice was properly delivered and received, specifying the noncompliant act and a termination date more than thirty days after receipt. The covered breach involves an obligation under R.C. 5321.05. Conclusion The court should grant possession to the plaintiff.
